audit.whatIsWrong: Every level-chart row reads Vayne while the whys underneath them all describe Garen winning levels 1-5. The packet flagged the same contradiction.
audit.why: Mirror (garen__vayne) already flipped rows 0-4 to Garen and left rows 5-6 as Vayne. That matches the packet chart and matches this file's own whys[0..4] text ('out-trade you from level 1', 'keep you off the lane'). diff/diffRating also disagreed with a 54.42% win rate over 3302 games — HARD 6/10 on a lane Vayne wins.
audit.corrected: Chart: Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Vayne, Vayne. diff FAV, diffRating 4/10.

audit.why: The four spikes are accurate: Garen owns 3-5, holds an execute at 6, still out-trades into his first item, and the two-item mark flips to Vayne. Only the chart contradicted them.
audit.corrected: Spike text left as written; the chart is corrected to agree with it.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere (packet: sequencingCues 0), and Courage's tenacity plus shield was never mentioned.
audit.why: Decisive Strike is a flat 8s and its silence shuts off both Tumble and Condemn, so it is the single cooldown the lane runs on. Judgment reaches only 325 and drops to 6s at rank 5 — outside that radius it is free damage for you. Courage gives a shield and tenacity for a brief window on a 22s cooldown at rank 1, absorbing exactly the burst you are trying to land.
audit.corrected: Commit only after Decisive Strike (8s) is spent, stay outside 325 to ignore Judgment, and wait out Courage rather than bursting into it.

audit.why: Concrete numbers make it actionable: Q 8s flat, E 9s falling to 6s, W 22s falling to 12s, R 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d.

edits.after: Overall difficulty: 4/10. Garen owns levels 1-5; from your first item on, kiting a kit with no gap-closer wins it.

notes: The whole level chart contradicted its own whys and the packet; all five flipped rows are proposed as matched full/content pairs in one group, with ratings rescaled to Vayne's perspective. diff/diffRating/tone said HARD on a 54.42% lane and are corrected to FAV 4/10 green. Decisive Strike silencing Condemn as well as Tumble, and Courage's tenacity, were both absent and are now stated.
